312:   def pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, effect)
313:     priority.each do |battler|
314:       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[effect] == 0
315:       battler.effects[effect] -= 1
316:       yield battler if block_given? && battler.effects[effect] == 0
317:     end
318:   end

320:   def pbEOREndBattlerEffects(priority)
321:     # Taunt
322:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Taunt) do |battler|
323:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s taunt wore off!", battler.pbThis))
324:     end
325:     # Encore
326:     priority.each do |battler|
327:       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] == 0
328:       idxEncoreMove = battler.pbEncoredMoveIndex
329:       if idxEncoreMove >= 0
330:         battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] -= 1
331:         if battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] == 0 || battler.moves[idxEncoreMove].pp == 0
332:           battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] = 0
333:           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s encore ended!", battler.pbThis))
334:         end
335:       else
336:         PBDebug.log("[End of effect] #{battler.pbThis}'s encore ended (encored move no longer known)")
337:         battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore]     = 0
338:         battler.effects[PBEffects::EncoreMove] = nil
339:       end
340:     end
341:     # Disable/Cursed Body
342:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Disable) do |battler|
343:       battler.effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] = nil
344:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is no longer disabled!", battler.pbThis))
345:     end
346:     # Magnet Rise
347:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::MagnetRise) do |battler|
348:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s electromagnetism wore off!", battler.pbThis))
349:     end
350:     # Telekinesis
351:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Telekinesis) do |battler|
352:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was freed from the telekinesis!", battler.pbThis))
353:     end
354:     # Heal Block
355:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::HealBlock) do |battler|
356:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s Heal Block wore off!", battler.pbThis))
357:     end
358:     # Embargo
359:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Embargo) do |battler|
360:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} can use items again!", battler.pbThis))
361:       battler.pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck
362:     end
363:     # Yawn
364:     pbEORCountDownBattlerEffect(priority, PBEffects::Yawn) do |battler|
365:       if battler.pbCanSleepYawn?
366:         PBDebug.log("[Lingering effect] #{battler.pbThis} fell asleep because of Yawn")
367:         battler.pbSleep
368:       end
369:     end
370:     # Perish Song
371:     perishSongUsers = []
372:     priority.each do |battler|
373:       next if battler.fainted? || battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 0
374:       battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] -= 1
375:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s perish count fell to {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong]))
376:       if battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 0
377:         perishSongUsers.push(battler.effects[PBEffects::PerishSongUser])
378:         battler.pbReduceHP(battler.hp)
379:       end
380:       battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
381:       battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
382:     end
383:     # Judge if all remaining Pokemon fainted by a Perish Song triggered by a single side
384:     if perishSongUsers.length > 0 &&
385:        ((perishSongUsers.find_all { |idxBattler| opposes?(idxBattler) }.length == perishSongUsers.length) ||
386:        (perishSongUsers.find_all { |idxBattler| !opposes?(idxBattler) }.length == perishSongUsers.length))
387:       pbJudgeCheckpoint(@battlers[perishSongUsers[0]])
388:     end
389:     return if @decision > 0
390:   end

471:   def pbEOREndTerrain
472:     # Count down terrain duration
473:     @field.terrainDuration -= 1 if @field.terrainDuration > 0
474:     # Terrain wears off
475:     if @field.terrain != :None && @field.terrainDuration == 0
476:       case @field.terrain
477:       when :Electric
478:         pbDisplay(_INTL("The electric current disappeared from the battlefield!"))
479:       when :Grassy
480:         pbDisplay(_INTL("The grass disappeared from the battlefield!"))
481:       when :Misty
482:         pbDisplay(_INTL("The mist disappeared from the battlefield!"))
483:       when :Psychic
484:         pbDisplay(_INTL("The weirdness disappeared from the battlefield!"))
485:       end
486:       @field.terrain = :None
487:       allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
488:       # Start up the default terrain
489:       if @field.defaultTerrain != :None
490:         pbStartTerrain(nil, @field.defaultTerrain, false)
491:         allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
492:         allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbItemTerrainStatBoostCheck }
493:       end
494:       return if @field.terrain == :None
495:     end
496:     # Terrain continues
497:     terrain_data = GameData::BattleTerrain.try_get(@field.terrain)
498:     pbCommonAnimation(terrain_data.animation) if terrain_data
499:     case @field.terrain
500:     when :Electric then pbDisplay(_INTL("An electric current is running across the battlefield."))
501:     when :Grassy   then pbDisplay(_INTL("Grass is covering the battlefield."))
502:     when :Misty    then pbDisplay(_INTL("Mist is swirling about the battlefield."))
503:     when :Psychic  then pbDisplay(_INTL("The battlefield is weird."))
504:     end
505:   end

539:   #=============================================================================
540:   # End Of Round shift distant battlers to middle positions
541:   #=============================================================================
542:   def pbEORShiftDistantBattlers
543:     # Move battlers around if none are near to each other
544:     # NOTE: This code assumes each side has a maximum of 3 battlers on it, and
545:     #       is not generalised to larger side sizes.
546:     if !singleBattle?
547:       swaps = []   # Each element is an array of two battler indices to swap
548:       2.times do |side|
549:         next if pbSideSize(side) == 1   # Only battlers on sides of size 2+ need to move
550:         # Check if any battler on this side is near any battler on the other side
551:         anyNear = false
552:         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
553:           anyNear = allOtherSideBattlers(battler).any? { |other| nearBattlers?(other.index, battler.index) }
554:           break if anyNear
555:         end
556:         break if anyNear
557:         # No battlers on this side are near any battlers on the other side; try
558:         # to move them
559:         # NOTE: If we get to here (assuming both sides are of size 3 or less),
560:         #       there is definitely only 1 able battler on this side, so we
561:         #       don't need to worry about multiple battlers trying to move into
562:         #       the same position. If you add support for a side of size 4+,
563:         #       this code will need revising to account for that, as well as to
564:         #       add more complex code to ensure battlers will end up near each
565:         #       other.
566:         allSameSideBattlers(side).each do |battler|
567:           # Get the position to move to
568:           pos = -1
569:           case pbSideSize(side)
570:           when 2 then pos = [2, 3, 0, 1][battler.index]   # The unoccupied position
571:           when 3 then pos = (side == 0) ? 2 : 3    # The centre position
572:           end
573:           next if pos < 0
574:           # Can't move if the same trainer doesn't control both positions
575:           idxOwner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(battler.index)
576:           next if pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(pos) != idxOwner
577:           swaps.push([battler.index, pos])
578:         end
579:       end
580:       # Move battlers around
581:       swaps.each do |pair|
582:         next if pbSideSize(pair[0]) == 2 && swaps.length > 1
583:         next if !pbSwapBattlers(pair[0], pair[1])
584:         case pbSideSize(pair[1])
585:         when 2
586:           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved across!", @battlers[pair[1]].pbThis))
587:         when 3
588:           pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved to the center!", @battlers[pair[1]].pbThis))
589:         end
590:       end
591:     end
592:   end
